topology.description: Team shape as a non-empty string. The runtime gate reads this with `isinstance(topology, str)` and treats anything else as absent (agentlas_cloud/team_shape.py). An object or null therefore passed this schema and then failed the gate — the value was `required` here without ever being defined, so a generator had nothing to conform to. `single-agent` is the one reserved value: it means the package must NOT carry an orchestrator/HQ. Every other non-empty string is a multi-agent team; published teams use `multi-agent-team`, `hub-and-spoke`, `orchestrated-team` and others, and all of them are valid.

edges.description: Handoff edges. The team gate fails a multi-agent package with an empty or missing `edges`, so a team that declares nodes must declare how work moves between them.
